scope: Two public one-token tiny-GPT2 fixtures; actual CPU cryptographic operations in separate client/evaluator processes; not simulation or a full-model performance qualification
command: DOPPLER_CONCRETE_NATIVE=1 DOPPLER_CONCRETE_MODEL_DIR=<pinned-local-fixture> DOPPLER_CONCRETE_REPORT_DIR=<local-evidence-directory> OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS=2 RAYON_NUM_THREADS=2 python -m unittest discover -s tools/privacy-concrete -p test_*.py -v
memoryScope: Operating-system process high-water marks in one test interpreter, including preceding native tests; child high-water may include earlier evaluator processes. Not per-request incremental memory or a total across simultaneous processes.
timingScope: Function-entry-to-return and per-step clocks; Python/library import time excluded. Each function run includes model loading, public calibration, fresh key generation, key/weight upload, four encrypted steps, full local encrypted replay and local reference checks. Concurrent repository/host work was not excluded.
trafficScope: Actual binary frame bytes including fresh public evaluation-key and public-weight upload; local pipes, not a network measurement.
